caveats.appearance: P(appear) is the probability of at least one championship-window stat row; it is not a breakout or usefulness probability
caveats.bootstrap: the 90% intervals are player-cluster bootstraps conditional on the fixed fits and the realized origins 2012-2025; they carry no season or model-fit uncertainty and are not forecast intervals
caveats.horizons: each horizon is fitted, evaluated and selected independently; acceptance at one horizon never validates another
caveats.labels: a complete season with no artifact row is the producers' shared convention zero (tagged); seasons beyond 2025 are unknown
caveats.population: a draft-population prior for drafted players with no rookie-year regular-season record; not conditioned on remaining on a current roster; direction and size of this mismatch have not been measured
caveats.scoring: outcomes are the common research default PPR championship-window target (nflverse default scoring), not exact league scoring; league_scoring_exact is false on the bound artifact
caveats.selection: selecting a policy on this historical evaluation is retrospective model selection, NOT independent confirmation of the selected policy; both arms are reported at every horizon

age_fallback.rule: training position median first, then the overall training median only when the same position has no observed age; unsupported when no training age exists at all (ex-ante missing-feature rule)

1.selection_rule: per horizon, on the same paired supported rows: the candidate is selected only if BOTH the paired Brier(appear) difference and the paired RMSE(unconditional points) difference vs B1 have 90% player-cluster bootstrap intervals entirely below zero; otherwise B1's estimate is a baseline_research_candidate with its measured out-of-time error and support; a horizon whose arms are unsupported at the final origin is unsupported
